governor.purpose: hardest cross-domain planning, synthesis, computer/tool workflows

coding_worker.rule: record actual model; do not hard-code stale codex model
coding_worker.authority: isolated branch + tests + PR; no merge

golden_independent_review.purpose: high-stakes independent review of code, content and Golden milestones

routine_independent_review.purpose: daily independent code/architecture review at lower cost than Golden reviewer

multimodal_ingest.purpose: high-volume long-running multimodal ingestion/analysis and secondary challenge

embeddings.purpose: hybrid semantic retrieval over LUMEN knowledge

interactive_voice.purpose: live spoken guide and audio interaction

rules: Provider/model is never inferred from configuration; runtime must report it.
Author model cannot be sole Golden reviewer.
Fallback must preserve output schema and evidence contract.
Routine work may route to cheaper models; canonical work uses quality-first tier.
No model may increase its own cost ceiling.
